source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub or small tree to 8 m; foliage essentially evergreen
morphology_documented.leaves: Obovate to oblong-elliptic, entire or somewhat toothed, up to about 7 × 3.5 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Loose leafy-bracted racemes, bracts much smaller than leaves; white corollas 4–6 mm long; inferior ovary
morphology_documented.fruit: Black or reddish-black berries, dryish/mealy to moist
morphology_documented.habitat: Sandy soils, open woods, thickets and fields

source_scope_note: Species vs genus/key-level characters distinguished in text; no undocumented characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Regional flora describes mainly eastern Texas sites, not an independently validated Hays county distribution
preservation: Additive research record, existing species cards, original media, credits and galleries unchanged
